content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Green Bay

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Attend instructor-led sessions online, participate in real-time Q&A, and access recorded content. The course covers all five PMBOK® process groups and prepares you to apply project management knowledge across manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and other Green Bay industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp hours, submit your PMI credential application online. You will need to document your project experience and pay the PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process and answer application questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Study using Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice questions, and study guides. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Granite PM Academy's instructors remain available to clarify complex topics before you sit for the 200-question, four-hour exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Certification
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential renews every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through project work, training, and volunteering. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continuing education and career growth throughout the renewal cycle.
